{{Quote|You do not speak in the presence of the Miskara until spoken to,|The guard|<ref name="Outbound Flight" />}}
A '''Vagaari guard''' member of the [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] nomadic [[Species/Legends|species]] and their [[Vagaari Empire|empire]] served aboard the Vagaari species [[Miskara|ruler's]] [[The Miskara's flagship|warship]]<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> After [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jorj Car'das]] arrived at the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] and was brought to the [[Unidentified Miskara (Jorj Car'das)|Miskara]], the ruler of the Vagaari, the guard reprimanded and hit the Human, as he had spoken to the Miskara before he was spoken to. Then, Car'das remained silent, and was complimented by the Vagaari ruler, who engaged in a conversation with the Human. The guard, along with all the Vagaari on the warship were later [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Jedi Master]] [[Jorus C'baoth]] and all the [[The Force/Legends|Force-wielding]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] aboard the massive [[Starship/Legends|starship]] the Miskara and his [[Vagaari slaver fleet|fleet]] attempted to [[Battle for Outbound Flight|seize]], ''[[Outbound Flight]]'', as the force users performed a [[Force-meld|Force meld]] which destroyed all of the Vagaari's minds, killing them.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

==Behind the scenes==
The guard appeared in the [[2007]] novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Outbound Flight" />
